question.text: If <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> is the largest interval in which the function <math><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></math> is decreasing, then <math><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to (where, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced open="[" close="]"><mo>.</mo></mfenced></math> denotes the greatest integer function)
